definitions.explanation: A person who swims, especially one engaged in swimming as an activity or sport.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遠泳|えんえい}→遠泳：15159_enei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{泳者|えいしゃ}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The long-distance swimmers entered the sea.

examples.japanese: {泳者|えいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ライフ⟦ガード→ガード：22870_gaado⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Lifeguards were stationed to protect the swimmers' safety.

examples.japanese: トライアスロン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{泳者|えいしゃ}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{過酷|かこく}→過酷：10901_kakoku⟧な⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{泳|およ}ぎ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ステージ→ステージ：11047_suteeji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The triathletes swam through the grueling course and advanced to the next stage.

notes:
A compound of {泳|えい} (swimming) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). This is a somewhat formal or literary word. In everyday conversation, ⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (person who swims) or the loanword スイマー (swimmer) is more common. {泳者|えいしゃ} tends to appear in news reports, sports coverage, and written descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{遠泳|えんえい}→遠泳：15159_enei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{泳者|えいしゃ}: long-distance swimmer
- {泳者|えいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧: swimmer safety
- ⟦{競泳|きょうえい}→競泳：15481_kyouei⟧{泳者|えいしゃ}: competitive swimmer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- スイマー: swimmer (loanword; more casual and commonly used in sports)
- ⟦{水泳選手|すいえいせんしゅ}→水泳選手：29200_suieisenshu⟧: competitive swimmer; swimming athlete
- {泳|およ}ぎ{手|て}: swimmer (native Japanese compound; informal)
